title: 2013 Honda Pilot Fender Replacement and Door Molding Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair replaced the driver-side fender and refinished all four door moldings on a maroon 2013 Honda Pilot.
story: This maroon 2013 Honda Pilot came in for body repairs along the driver side. The driver-side front fender was damaged beyond standard reshaping and required a complete replacement to maintain panel alignment.

After removing the old fender, a replacement panel was fitted and aligned relative to the hood, front bumper, and driver door. Technicians sanded and primed the surface to ensure smooth paint adhesion and color blending.
All four door moldings also had scrapes and surface damage. The shop repaired each molding trim piece before refinishing and repainting them to match the factory maroon color.
